class.name: pilotaro_controllers/CascadeController
class.description: Cascaded multirotor controller: position P, velocity PI, attitude PD on SO(3) and pseudo-inverse motor allocation.

class.name: pilotaro_controllers/UnderwaterController
class.description: 6 DOF controller for vehicles with vectored, reversible thrusters (ROVs, AUVs): position P and velocity PI with added mass, damping and buoyancy feedforward, level attitude on SO(3) and pseudo-inverse thruster allocation.
